reuse.why: Takes its categories from the shared getMonthActionCategories, writes through setBudget inside batchMessages and reads the previous month's sum-amount sheet cell like the other actions, and is registered with mutator(undoable(...)) like its siblings.

duplication.why: Only the per-action idioms repeat (income/tracking skip and expense sign flip, as in set3MonthAvg); no new copied category query or spending computation.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts next to setZero and the average actions, and the method is registered in budget/app.ts with the others.

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration and its tests are added.

maintainability.why: Small, idiomatic function that follows the established shape of the month-wide actions; category-selection changes would automatically apply to it.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getMonthActionCategories rather than its own category query.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic beyond the repeated income-skip/sign idiom shared by all month-wide actions.
